'''Yuvernians''' were a two-headed [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] from the [[Yuvern system]], they each had two spot-covered heads sitting atop a long neck. [[Cane Adiss]], a member of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]]'s [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]], was a [[Gender|male]] Yuvernian.<ref name="Geektionary" />
